items.title: Rename and reposition the design around lifecycle readiness instead of pipeline execution
items.context: The current document title and command/model names imply an execution pipeline. Reframe the doc as Lattice Lifecycle Proof-Or-Stop Readiness Check, with Lifecycle Readiness Check as the short name, Full Vision separated from V1, and StoryReadinessReport replacing StoryPipelineReport in the design language.

items.title: Constrain V1 to a read-only readiness control tower with exact next actions
items.context: The external host review correctly identified that the first useful slice should read state, artifacts, freshness, review lanes, validation, delivery context, and done_prepare dry-run output without writing evidence, launching reviewers, advancing phases, or claiming Authority completion.

items.title: Patch the concrete contract gaps found in review
items.context: Address the verified gaps: REVIEW/TEST to DEV rollback must have exact commands; delivery blockers must distinguish artifact-only from material rework; default options must not masquerade as executable DONE automation; done_prepare reuse must distinguish pre/post merge HEAD; refresh-only loops need a bound and escalation path.
